def minimumSwap(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) != len(s2):
        return -1
    
    count_x1 = s1.count('x')
    count_y1 = len(s1) - count_x1
    count_x2 = s2.count('x')
    count_y2 = len(s2) - count_x2
    
    if (count_x1 + count_x2) % 2 != 0 or (count_y1 + count_y2) % 2 != 0:
        return -1
    
    diff_x = sum(1 for i in range(len(s1)) if s1[i] != s2[i] and s1[i] == 'x')
    diff_y = len(s1) - diff_x
    
    swaps = diff_x // 2 + diff_y // 2
    if diff_x % 2 == 1:
        swaps += 2
    
    return swaps
